locator.text: Display 147.6, p. 147, in the proof of Proposition B.2

provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The Lean never forms the bare products: the parameter derivative and the logarithmic radial derivative appear only inside the bounded bilinear operator `inverseMixed`, documented and estimated as J_r((∂_η f)(D_Y g)). In `naturalRemainder` it is applied at exactly the two pairs the paper lists — (bu, φ) and (bu, u) with bu = O.average u = A_X(u) — and each occurrence is multiplied by the undifferentiated factor d, which (B.6)'s closing remark explicitly allows. So the paper's two products appear as d·J₂((∂_η A_X(u))·D_XΦ) and d·J₁((∂_η A_X(u))·D_X u), and the paper's bound (B.6) with its unnamed C_ρ is `norm_inverseMixed_le` with the explicit 5120/ε.
